title: nan
authors: Mostafa M.; Zahran S.; Moussa A.; El-Sheimy N.; Sesay A.
key_contribution: Presents an integrated navigation architecture fusing Radar Odometry (RO), enhanced Visual Odometry (VO), IMU, barometer, and magnetometer via EKF for UAVs during GNSS outages.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
